user.title: Authentication
user.description: Sharp's login page requires solving a CAPTCHA, so log in once at https://cocoroplusapp.jp.sharp/air in your browser, then copy the `Cookie` request header from a request to cocoroplusapp.jp.sharp in your browser's devtools and paste it below.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Cocoro Air
reconfigure.description: Update your Cocoro Air session cookie or device settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Cocoro Air
reauth_confirm.description: Your session cookie has expired. Log in again at https://cocoroplusapp.jp.sharp/air, copy the `Cookie` request header, and paste it below.
